encounters.trigger: Destroying the Obsidian Sentinel triggers an ancient mechanism, unlocking the path to the final boss chamber.

level.setting: A collapsing volcanic chamber filled with molten rivers, unstable terrain, and erupting geysers.

encounters.location: Near the edge of the magma river
encounters.hazard: Molten lava flows periodically, causing damage if not avoided.

pickup.name: Soul of Molten Stone
pickup.effect: Increases player's fire resistance by 25% and temporarily boosts weapon damage by 5.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Magma Wraith causes the ground to crack, revealing a hidden tunnel to the next encounter.

encounters.location: A chamber filled with swirling ash and unstable rock pillars.
encounters.hazard: Rock pillars collapse randomly, blocking paths and forcing alternate routes.

pickup.name: Crimson Ember
pickup.effect: Temporary fire aura that deals damage to nearby enemies and increases player's critical strike chance by 30%.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Ash Demon, a volcanic tremor opens the way to the final boss chamber.

encounters.location: The heart of the volcano, a massive chamber with lava geysers and a molten throne.
encounters.hazard: Lava geysers erupt in random patterns, damaging the player if not dodged.

pickup.name: Eternal Flame Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks ultimate fire-based ability that deals massive area-of-effect damage.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Lava King, the volcano collapses, ending the level and granting the player the Eternal Flame Core.

boss.name: The Lava King
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Lava King by exploiting the fire aura from the Crimson Ember pickup.

level.objective: Survive the volcanic chaos, defeat three enemies, and conquer the Lava King using the pickups you've collected.
level.reward: Eternal Flame Core, increased fire damage, and permanent fire resistance bonus.

level.setting: A molten fissure within the heart of a dormant volcano, with magma rivers and unstable terrain.

encounters.hazard: Magma surges can cause damage every 10 seconds if not avoided.

pickup.name: Volcanic Ember
pickup.effect: Increases player's weapon damage by 10% for 30 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Ash Wraith's defeat causes the magma to recede, revealing a hidden path toward the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Lava flows move toward the player at a constant rate; must be avoided or diverted.

pickup.name: Sundered Ash
pickup.effect: Reduces enemy armor by 20% for 15 seconds on hit.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Lava Golem causes a seismic shift in the cavern, opening a hidden chamber that leads to the final boss.

encounters.hazard: The chamber is unstable; every 20 seconds, a tremor damages the player unless they are on a safe platform.

pickup.name: Pyric Sigil
pickup.effect: Grants immunity to fire-based damage for 15 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Molten Overlord is awakened by the player's presence and attacks relentlessly until the player uses the Sundered Ash to weaken it.

boss.name: Molten Overlord
boss.victory_condition: Reduce health to 0 using the Sundered Ash to break its armor and deal critical damage.

level.objective: Survive and defeat the Molten Overlord, protecting the surrounding region from a new volcanic eruption.
level.reward: Pyric Sigil, access to new areas, and increased player resilience against fire-based threats.

level.setting: A desolate, lava-scorched wasteland with jagged obsidian spires and smoldering fissures in the ground.

enemy.name: Ashborn Wraith
enemy.weakness: Fire resistance is reduced by 50% if the player has the 'Blade of Infernal Rage' equipped.

encounters.hazard: Lava surges randomly from the ground, dealing 25 damage per second if the player stands still for more than 5 seconds.

pickup.name: Infernal Core
pickup.effect: Increases fire resistance by 30%, grants +15% damage to flame-based enemies.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Ashborn Wraith causes the ground to crack open, revealing a path to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Magma Golem
enemy.weakness: If the 'Infernal Core' pickup is equipped, the Magma Golem's armor becomes brittle and takes 25% more damage.

encounters.hazard: Quakes shake the terrain, causing the player to lose balance and take 30 damage if not dodging.

pickup.name: Tectonic Shard
pickup.effect: Allows the player to create shockwaves that knock enemies off balance for 3 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Crushing the Magma Golem triggers a deep tremor, opening a portal to the final encounter.

enemy.name: Volcanic Titan
enemy.weakness: If the 'Tectonic Shard' pickup is used, the Volcanic Titan's core becomes exposed and vulnerable to critical hits for 5 seconds.

encounters.hazard: The floor is unstable, with sections collapsing and revealing lava below. The player must navigate carefully or risk instant death.

pickup.name: Eruption Amulet
pickup.effect: Absorbs fire damage and converts it into temporary health (up to 200) and increases attack speed by 20% for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Volcanic Titan, the amulet is dropped and the volcano begins to collapse, sealing the player in a final test of endurance.

boss.name: The Molten Sovereign
boss.weakness: The 'Eruption Amulet' must be used in the final moments of the fight to deal 300% damage to the Sovereign's core.
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Molten Sovereign's core while standing on a stable platform to avoid being buried by the collapsing volcano.

level.objective: Survive the volcanic wasteland and defeat the Molten Sovereign, the last guardian of the realm.
level.reward: The player gains the 'Volcanic Berserker' title, a permanent 20% damage boost, and a unique skin for the Blade of Infernal Rage.

level.setting: A massive, ancient volcano with glowing magma rivers and jagged obsidian terrain.

encounters.hazard: Pillars of flame erupt randomly across the room.

pickup.name: Scorched Circuit
pickup.effect: Increases Thermal Disruptor damage by 10%

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Magma Wraith, a hidden tunnel opens, leading to the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: The floor cracks, revealing molten lava beneath.

pickup.name: Volcanic Core
pickup.effect: Restores 25% of player's health when picked up.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Obsidian Golem unlocks a sealed door, leading to the final boss chamber.

encounters.hazard: The arena is surrounded by erupting geysers and floating lava orbs.

pickup.name: Ashen Relic
pickup.effect: Unlocks a new ability: 'Molten Shield' (absorb 30% of incoming damage)

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Molten Sentinel to complete the level.

boss.name: The Molten Sentinel
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss using the Volcanic Core to reduce its damage by 50%.

level.objective: Navigate through the volcanic ruins, defeat three enemies, and destroy the Molten Sentinel by exploiting the weaknesses unlocked from pickups.
level.reward: Ashen Relic and access to the next volcanic region.

level.setting: A desolate volcanic wasteland filled with obsidian spires, smoldering fissures, and lava flows that glow with unnatural light.

encounters.hazard: Explosive ash clouds that ignite on proximity to the player.

pickup.name: Lava Core Crystal
pickup.effect: Boosts player's weapon damage by 20%

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Ash Warden unlocks a hidden path leading to the second encounter.

encounters.hazard: The floor is unstable and collapses with each enemy hit, causing player fall damage.

pickup.name: Storm Relic
pickup.effect: Unlocks a special storm-based ability that can summon a lightning strike.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Magma Wraith releases a pulse that activates the final path to the boss.

encounters.hazard: The chamber pulses with lava and occasional rock falls from the ceiling.

pickup.name: Eruption Amulet
pickup.effect: Grants temporary invincibility for 5 seconds when health is below 20%

encounters.trigger: The final encounter begins as the player reaches the chamber’s center after defeating the second enemy.

boss.name: The Molten One
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Molten One using the Storm Relic to unleash a powerful lightning storm that disrupts its molten form.

level.objective: Survive the volcanic terrain and defeat the Molten One, utilizing pickups from prior encounters to unlock the final attack.
level.reward: Access to the Stormforged Citadel, a sanctuary where the player can upgrade their Stormfang and gain new abilities.

level.setting: A whimsical, magical volcano filled with bubbling lava, floating lava stones, and playful lava creatures.

encounters.hazard: Lava geysers erupt randomly, stunning the player if they're in the path.

pickup.name: Lava Core Shard
pickup.effect: Grants temporary fire resistance and boosts player's damage by 5 for the next encounter.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Lava Pup, a path opens through the lava wall to reveal the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Pressure plates cause geysers to erupt, forcing the player to jump over lava jets.

pickup.name: Ember Feather
pickup.effect: Increases movement speed and allows the player to briefly float over small lava pools.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Magma Muncher, a glowing path leads to the final encounter with the boss.

encounters.hazard: The floor is unstable and cracks periodically, revealing lava underneath.

pickup.name: Volcanic Crown
pickup.effect: Unlocks a new ability: 'Eruption Blast' — a powerful AoE fire attack that can be used once every 30 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the boss, the volcano stabilizes, and a new path opens leading to the next area.

boss.name: Flameface the Flambassador
boss.victory_condition: Defeat Flameface using the Ember Feather to trigger a powerful counterattack that bypasses his fire shield.

level.objective: Navigate the whimsical volcanic landscape, defeat the playful lava creatures, and claim the Volcanic Crown to unlock new abilities for future adventures.
level.reward: Volcanic Crown, Ember Feather, and Lava Core Shard (if not already used)

level.setting: A dormant volcano with rivers of molten rock and crystalline structures that shimmer with energy. The air is warm, and the distant rumble of tectonic shifts echoes like a lullaby.

encounters.hazard: Periodic lava bursts from the ceiling

pickup.name: Eternal Core
pickup.effect: Increases Chrono Blade's Time Slow duration by 100%

encounters.trigger: The player defeats the Golem, unlocking the path to the Obsidian Pillar, where the next encounter begins.

encounters.hazard: Tremors cause the ground to crack and fall away

pickup.name: Chrono Lens
pickup.effect: Allows the player to see enemy weak points and slow them for 5 seconds

encounters.trigger: The Ash Warden is defeated, and the Chrono Lens activates a hidden path through a temporal rift, leading to the final encounter.

encounters.hazard: The environment shifts in time loops, forcing the player to navigate through past and future versions of the same area

pickup.name: Chrono Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Chrono Blade's ultimate ability: Time Freeze (temporarily halts all enemies)

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Eon Serpent with the Chrono Lens reveals the Chrono Core, which stabilizes the environment and allows the player to progress to the summit.

boss.name: Volcanic Chronomancer
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the core of the Volcanic Chronomancer using the Time Freeze ability.

level.objective: Reach the summit of the volcano and restore balance to the temporal rifts causing the volcanic unrest.
level.reward: Temporal Resonator - Allows the player to manipulate small time distortions in the environment for strategic advantage.

encounters.hazard: Floating debris that deals 5 damage on collision

pickup.name: Luminous Crystal
pickup.effect: Restores 20% of player's health

encounters.trigger: After defeating the wraith, the debris clears and the path to the next area opens

encounters.hazard: Gravity wells that slow movement and cause falling damage

pickup.name: Aetherial Sigil
pickup.effect: Increases player's damage by 10 for the next encounter

encounters.trigger: After defeating the sentinel, the gravity wells disappear, revealing the final path to the boss

encounters.hazard: Celestial storms that deal 10 damage per second

pickup.effect: Permanently increases max health by 30

boss.name: The Astral Sovereign

level.objective: Defend the Astral Sanctuary from corruption, restoring its balance with your celestial power.
level.reward: Celestial Crown and restored serenity of the sanctuary.

encounters.hazard: Gravity Wells (randomly pull player off edges)

pickup.name: Temporal Anchor
pickup.effect: Restores 300 HP and grants 20% resistance to time-based debuffs for 15 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeating Time Eater unlocks the Chrono Path, leading to the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Mirror Reflections (player must avoid mirrored versions of themselves)

pickup.name: Void Compass
pickup.effect: Highlights hidden pathways and reveals enemy positions for 20 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeating Echo Shard activates the Celestial Core, summoning the final boss.

encounters.hazard: Time Rifts (player can be pulled into alternate timelines, losing HP and status effects)

pickup.name: Celestial Sigil
pickup.effect: Unlocks a final time-slow ability for 10 seconds, dealing triple damage to the boss

boss.name: Chrono Seraph
boss.victory_condition: Use Celestial Sigil to slow time and deliver a decisive blow.

level.objective: Navigate through the fractured timelines of the Chronosphere, uncover the truth of time's collapse by defeating the Chrono Seraph.
level.reward: Chrono Sigil of Eternity (Permanently increases Chrono Lash damage by 25%)

level.setting: A shattered celestial realm where the stars bleed into the void, and the sky fractures into jagged obsidian shards.
level.player_weapon: Shadow Cleaver (100% chance to inflict 'Veil of Silence' on hit)

encounters.hazard: The battlefield is unstable; each attack causes a small gravity well that pulls the player toward the void.

pickup.name: Echo Core
pickup.effect: Grants a 15% chance to reduce enemy damage by 50% for 5 seconds on hit.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Voyager Sentinel, a rift opens above, pulling the player into the next zone.

encounters.hazard: The ground is unstable, shifting between solid and void with each step.

pickup.name: Celestial Shard
pickup.effect: Adds 15% chance to reflect 50% of incoming damage back to the enemy.

encounters.trigger: The Shattered Starborn collapses into a crystalline core, creating a beacon that summons the final boss.

encounters.hazard: The player is surrounded by shifting constellations that randomly alter the gravitational pull, making movement unpredictable.

pickup.name: Celestial Harmony
pickup.effect: Unlocks 'Shadow Nova' ability: AoE shadow damage with 100% chance to knock enemy back.

encounters.trigger: The Voidwraith Ascendant must be defeated with a precise sequence of strikes that reflect its own power back upon itself.

boss.name: The Voidwraith Ascendant
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Voidwraith with the Celestial Shard active to trigger a final 'Shadow Nova' that finishes the fight.

level.objective: Navigate the shattered celestial realm and defeat the Voidwraith Ascendant, using pickups from prior encounters to overcome each enemy and the final boss.
level.reward: Access to the Celestial Void, where the player can craft new celestial weaponry or unlock hidden realms.

encounters.hazard: Floating Petals that slow movement

pickup.name: Celestial Bloom
pickup.effect: Restores 20 HP

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Stardust Sprout causes a burst of light that summons the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Reflective surfaces that trap the player in illusions

pickup.name: Lunar Echo
pickup.effect: Increases player weapon damage by 5 for 3 encounters

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Moonshade Mimic causes a ripple across the lake, revealing a path to the boss.

encounters.hazard: Gravity shifts and time loops

pickup.name: Celestial Crown

encounters.trigger: The boss fight begins when the player enters the Nexus, after the path is revealed.

boss.name: Eclipsed Guardian
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Eclipsed Guardian using the Lunar Echo to break its illusions.

level.objective: Navigate the Celestial Gardens, defeat three illusion-based foes, and use your collected pickups to overcome the final celestial boss.
level.reward: Celestial Crown (permanent ability to create illusion duplicates)

level.setting: A shattered celestial realm where fragments of planets drift through a cosmic storm, colliding and exploding in bursts of radiant energy.

enemy.name: Aether Shatterling
enemy.weakness: Stormfang's lightning surges are amplified by the 'Celestial Core' pickup from this encounter.

encounters.hazard: The ground is unstable; every few seconds, a gravitational vortex pulls the player toward the void, dealing 10 damage each time.

pickup.name: Celestial Core
pickup.effect: Increases Stormfang's lightning damage by 20% for 30 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Aether Shatterling causes the Celestial Core to pulse, drawing in a nearby Celestial Rift that leads to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Void Serpent
enemy.weakness: The 'Celestial Core' from the previous encounter disrupts the Void Serpent’s energy field, allowing direct attacks.

encounters.hazard: A gravitational anomaly pulls the player toward the Void Serpent, dealing 15 damage per second if not avoided.

pickup.name: Starforged Armor
pickup.effect: Increases player armor by 25% for 45 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Void Serpent, the Starforged Armor begins to glow, signaling the location of the final boss.

enemy.name: The Chaos God: Entropy
enemy.weakness: The 'Starforged Armor' from the second encounter is the only defense against Entropy’s void energy, allowing the player to bypass its shield.

encounters.hazard: Entropic waves reduce player health by 5% every 3 seconds unless the player is under the shield from Starforged Armor.

pickup.name: Celestial Harmony
pickup.effect: Fully restores player health and grants a temporary shield.

encounters.trigger: After the player bypasses Entropy's shield using the Starforged Armor, a burst of celestial energy awakens the Celestial Harmony, which grants the player the strength to finish the fight.

boss.name: The Chaos God: Entropy
boss.weakness: The 'Starforged Armor' from the second encounter is the only defense against Entropy’s void energy, allowing the player to bypass its shield.
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the core of Entropy using the Celestial Harmony pickup and Stormfang.

level.objective: Survive the celestial chaos and defeat the Chaos God, Entropy, by leveraging pickups and overcoming environmental hazards.
level.reward: Celestial Dominion: A powerful celestial weapon and title that grants permanent damage boosts and cosmic abilities.

level.setting: A shattered moon orbiting a dying star

encounters.location: Floating debris field above a fractured crater
encounters.hazard: Gravity shifts cause unpredictable movement

pickup.name: Stellar Core
pickup.effect: Increases player damage by 10%

encounters.trigger: The wraith's destruction triggers a gravitational collapse, revealing a path to the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Glittering crystals reflect harmful energy beams

pickup.name: Orb of Light
pickup.effect: Heals 20% of player health upon pickup

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Void Stalker causes the crystals to stabilize, revealing a glowing portal to the final boss.

encounters.location: The heart of the shattered moon
encounters.hazard: Floating debris and gravitational storms

pickup.name: Eclipse Shard
pickup.effect: Unlocks a temporary invincibility shield for 5 seconds

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the leviathan, the player gains the Eclipse Shard and the moon stabilizes, ending the level.

boss.name: Celestial Leviathan
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the leviathan with the Orb of Light in hand

level.objective: Navigate through the shattered moon, defeat the celestial entities, and stop the leviathan from consuming the last remnants of light.

level.setting: A decaying starship drifting through the void between stars, its interior warped by ancient alien forces and unstable cosmic energies.

encounters.location: The ship’s main engine room, where the ceiling has collapsed into the void.

enemy.name: Fractured Starborn
enemy.weakness: Celestial Wrench (Player's weapon) - its energy core destabilizes when struck with precision.

encounters.hazard: Unstable gravitational field pulling the player toward the void if not careful.

pickup.name: Stellar Core Resonator
pickup.effect: Increases player weapon damage by 10 for the next encounter.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Fractured Starborn, the ship’s reactor core begins to destabilize, causing the next encounter to trigger.

encounters.location: The ship’s bridge, now a twisted void of light and shadow.

enemy.name: Void Warden
enemy.weakness: Stellar Core Resonator (pickup from prior encounter) - its shield flickers and becomes vulnerable when the resonator is used.

encounters.hazard: Pulsing void portals that spawn minor void entities if the player hesitates.

pickup.name: Celestial Circuit Board
pickup.effect: Activates the player’s weapon with a burst of energy, dealing 20 bonus damage on the next attack.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Void Warden, a new energy signature is detected leading to the ship's central core.

encounters.location: The ship’s central core, a swirling vortex of cosmic energy and unstable matter.

enemy.name: Celestial Sovereign
enemy.weakness: Celestial Circuit Board (pickup from prior encounter) - its crystalline armor shatters when charged with the board’s energy.

encounters.hazard: Explosive energy bursts and gravitational anomalies that can knock the player into the void.

pickup.name: Stellar Heart
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of player health and grants temporary immunity to all debuffs.

encounters.trigger: Upon entering the core, the Celestial Sovereign awakens and challenges the player to a final test.

boss.name: Celestial Sovereign
boss.weakness: Celestial Circuit Board - its armor becomes vulnerable when the board is used to charge the player's weapon.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Sovereign without falling into the void.

level.objective: Navigate the decaying starship, survive the unstable environment, and defeat the Celestial Sovereign.
level.reward: Stellar Heart and a fragment of the ship's original design blueprints, hinting at its true purpose.

level.setting: A derelict space station orbiting a dying star, riddled with unstable energy fields and automated defenses.

encounters.hazard: Fluctuating magnetic fields may disrupt weapon aiming for 2 seconds.

pickup.name: Energy Capacitor
pickup.effect: Increases player weapon damage by 5 for the next encounter.

encounters.trigger: Player must repair a damaged reactor to power up the next section of the station, triggering the second encounter.

encounters.hazard: Gravity fields may cause brief stasis on the player for 3 seconds.

pickup.name: Gravity Anchor
pickup.effect: Reduces enemy movement speed by 30% for 5 seconds when used.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Sentinel Unit unlocks access to the Core Chamber, where the final boss awaits.

encounters.hazard: The Core Guardian emits a pulsating energy field that drains 5% health every 10 seconds.

pickup.name: Celestial Core
pickup.effect: Restores full player health and grants a 10% damage boost.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Core Guardian unlocks the station's data vault, completing the level.

boss.name: The Core Guardian
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Core Guardian and retrieve the Celestial Core.

level.objective: Repair the station's core to stabilize the dying star and escape before the station collapses.
